title: Return twice ends a bulleted list
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeGmail and open a new message
In the body type - and a space, then Milk, Return, Eggs
Press Return twice, then type Thanks
expected: - and a space start a bulleted list, Return adds a bullet, Return on the empty bullet ends the list and Thanks is a normal line. Backspace right after a bullet removes the bullet and keeps the text.
